name: first try: solved with no ring and no help
self-corrected: a ring classified locally, then the fix
a model mistake wins over the local one for the same read
a line read again with the same mistake counts it once; another kind adds one
with help: a hint and the tutor's step, then the student's answer
the tutor solves it: tutor_solved, and the student's answer after it stays the tutor's
answered first, then the tutor's solve: still the student's, now with help
a ring after the answer: first try becomes self-corrected, finishedAt stays
unfinished, then answered on coming back: finishedAt moves to the answer
a chat problem: given, the student's lines under it, a Now you try after it
a practice set: a problem written and never touched is never recorded
a problem known by its cell before its problem signal (a reload): tutor_problem, then given
taught: a worked solution the chat wrote
the tutor solves a problem it does not know yet (a line never sent)
help before the problem's first line is kept and counted; old help is not
labels and scratch the tutor never judged: never recorded, forgotten when closed
active time: gaps capped at two minutes, time on another problem not counted
the same line again changes nothing and does not open a closed attempt
the student's head line read again: the problem and its skill follow it
idle: closed after thirty minutes, opened again by a new line
the board closed: open attempts end unfinished; another board's are left alone
a system: its lines joined, classified as one problem
a long problem is cut to 500 characters
saving: a failure a retry can fix keeps them pending; one refused as invalid is dropped
coming back to the board goes on with the same attempt
a ring under a ringed line is the student correcting it: no local mistake for the fix
mistakes the local classifier names across kinds
a question mark is no verdict; a line ticked then unmarked stays judged
many problems on two screens, the course unknown
